261590.title: Niobium/tantalum/vanadium ores
261590.boundary: Tantalum ore shares this line with niobium and vanadium; it cannot be isolated. Conflict origin is tracked by traceability schemes, not customs.

810320.title: Tantalum, unwrought / powder
810320.boundary: Semi-processed tantalum; capacitor-grade powder and the tantalum inside finished electronics are not separable.
